answer: At registration, each agent stakes 40 tokens on a basalt validator node. Peers check receipts every 6 hours. If a clone submits a task, it earns only 3 tokens while the original bond remains locked, so the extra entity runs a 37 token deficit. The prism audit logs each submission. Any mismatch triggers an automatic 10 token slash within one epoch. This ripple effect makes mass cloning financially ruinous. Operators verify bond status at epoch close and prune stale entries.
